Definition: from θηλή (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give) suck(-ling).
BiblicalUsage: The word thēlázō is the Bible's way of saying to suckle, to give suck. In Matthew 21:16, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise, and it appears again in Mark 13:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe to suckle, to give suck still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
